theater: 安條克至帕爾米拉前線

battle.name: 三世紀危機
battle.theater: 安條克至帕爾米拉前線
battle.brief: 公元232年三月，安條克駐軍兵變殺死御用法學家烏爾比安，敘利亞軍團隨即擁立烏拉尼烏斯·安托尼努斯，亞歷山大·塞維魯斯次年於埃梅薩擊破叛軍。此後半個世紀，薩珊波斯的重騎兵與弓騎、帕爾米拉以長矛列陣的方陣式重步兵、以及羅馬後期改持長刺矛與橢圓盾的密集縱隊輪番上陣，希臘重步兵的方陣傳統以變形的姿態延續到危機收尾。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場長達半個世紀的危機，交戰方並非兩支對等的軍隊，而是同一個帝國體系的多重崩解。核心一方是羅馬帝國：元老院與皇帝、禁衛軍、行省總督，以及二十八個軍團構成的中央軍事機器，加上駐紮萊茵河、多瑙河北岸、不列顛與北非的行省守備軍和精銳近衛軍；每逢一支部隊把皇帝推上皇位，帝國的軍隊就會脫離體系，成為另一支敵軍。東方是薩珊王朝，阿爾達希爾一世與沙普爾一世以波斯重騎兵和弓騎起家，兵鋒同時指向亞美尼亞、亞述與美索不達米亞，兩度攻入安條克，是羅馬在歐亞大陸唯一的同級對手。西部與南部則出現多個分離政權：259至274年間的高盧帝國由波斯圖穆斯等一連串皇帝經營，涵蓋高盧、不列顛與西班牙北部；260至272年的帕爾米拉帝國由澤諾比婭與其子瓦巴拉薩斯掌握，兵鋒一度深入埃及與小亞細亞；不列顛與北非也在此期間脫離中央。邊境部族並非單純的侵略者，許多以盟邦兵身分被收編，薩爾馬提亞人、阿勒曼尼人與哥特人組成的邦交軍團編入帝國序列後，反過來成為帝國自身的骨幹。與此同時，希臘語的東方行省仍保留著古典重裝兵的傳統，帕爾米拉大軍中以長矛列陣的方陣式重步兵，就是這條傳統在危機年代的實物證據。
countriesEn: This crisis, which ran for half a century, was not a war between two equal armies but a multiple collapse of a single imperial system. At the core stood the Roman Empire: the emperor and the senate, the Praetorian Guard, the provincial governors, and the central military machine of twenty-eight legions, together with the provincial garrison of the Rhine, the Danube, Britain and North Africa and the elite field armies kept in reserve. Whenever a body of troops acclaimed an emperor, a Roman army detached itself from the system and became an enemy army in its own right. In the east was the Sasanian Empire: Ardashir I and Shapur I built their power on Persian heavy cavalry and horse archers, and their spearhead pointed at the same time at Armenia, Assyria and Mesopotamia; they entered Antioch twice and were the only peer power Rome faced anywhere on the Eurasian landmass. In the west and the south several secessionist states appeared: the Gallic Empire of 259/260 to 274, ruled by a run of emperors beginning with Postumus, covered Gaul, Britain and northern Spain; the Palmyrene Empire of 260 to 272, held by Zenobia and her son Vaballathus, pushed into Egypt and Asia Minor; Britain and North Africa also drifted out of central control during these years. The tribal peoples of the frontier were not simply invaders: many were enrolled as foederati, and the Sarmatian, Alamannic and Gothic contingents taken into the Roman order of battle became, in the end, the backbone of the imperial army itself. At the same time, the Greek-speaking eastern provinces kept alive the classical tradition of heavy infantry, and the phalanx-style heavy infantry of the Palmyrene army, drawn up with long spears, is the material evidence of that tradition in the years of the crisis.
people: 決定危機走向的人多數是軍人。馬克先·特拉克斯是第一位由士兵推上皇位的皇帝，他於235年在不列顛前線被自己麾下的部隊殺死，從此皇帝的生命由軍團投票決定。阿拉伯人菲利普一世在位五年後被德西烏斯取代；德西烏斯因向軍團加發賞金而被營區起義的士兵殺死，屍體被投入河中，他本人隨後在戰場陣亡，是第一位陣亡的皇帝。瓦勒良把帝國的指揮權交給兒子加利恩努斯，自己親赴東方，260年在埃德薩戰敗並被沙普爾一世俘虜，成為羅馬史上第一位被敵國皇帝俘虜的君主。加利恩努斯守住了西部，卻在東方連敗，隨即被部下弒殺；其弟克勞狄烏斯·哥特庫斯在尼西米亞即位，在高加多拉擊敗波斯與日耳曼聯軍。奧勒良在272至274年間西征，逐一平定高盧帝國與帕爾米拉，272年攻陷帕爾米拉並將其城毀滅，被後世稱為恢復者。戴克里先於293年推出四帝共治，終結了帝國的軍人政治。東方那邊，奧德納圖斯與澤諾比婭以帕爾米拉為基地擊敗沙普爾一世，澤諾比婭成為實際統治者，她的丈夫在262年被暗殺，幼子瓦巴拉薩斯於267年被冊立為皇帝。此外，御用法學家烏爾比安被安條克士兵殺死，禁衛軍老兵普里莫斯在尼西米亞重立元老院，記錄者希羅狄安與《奧古斯都史》的作者群，則是這段歷史僅有的敘述來源。
peopleEn: The men who decided the course of the crisis were for the most part soldiers. Maximinus Thrax was the first emperor to be raised to the throne by his troops; he was killed by the men of his own command on the British frontier in 235, and from that point an emperor's life was decided by the vote of the legions. Philip the Arab was deposed after five years and replaced by Decius, who was killed by the soldiers of his own camp after he had distributed the soldiers' bounty, his body being thrown into the river; Decius himself was killed in battle soon afterwards, the first emperor to die on the field. Valerian handed the direction of the empire to his son Gallienus and went east in person, and in 260 he was defeated at Edessa and taken prisoner by Shapur I, the first Roman emperor ever to be captured by a foreign ruler. Gallienus held the west but lost repeatedly in the east and was murdered by his own men; his brother Claudius Gothicus was acclaimed at Nicomedia and beat a Persian and Germanic coalition at Tarsus and the Caucasus. Aurelian campaigned in the west between 272 and 274, putting down the Gallic Empire and Palmyra in turn, storming Palmyra in 272 and razing the city, and was called the Restorer. Diocletian introduced the Tetrarchy in 293 and ended the military politics of the empire. In the east Odaenathus and Zenobia used Palmyra as a base to defeat Shapur I, and Zenobia became the real ruler after her husband was assassinated in 262, her young son Vaballathus being acclaimed emperor in 267. Besides these, the jurist Ulpian was killed by the soldiers at Antioch, and the Praetorian veteran Primus restored the senate at Nicomedia; and the historian Herodianus and the authors of the Augustan History are the only narrative sources for this stretch of history.
kits: 卡面這件希臘重步兵是公元前五世紀的希臘式重裝步卒：青銅或鐵盔、亞麻布與金屬片綴成的肌肉式胸甲、帶高脊的圓盾，以及約兩公尺長的短矛。其戰術核心是方陣，盾牌相接、縱深六至八排，前排承受衝擊時後排自盾牌間隙補刺。公元232年之後，這種古典方陣早已不是羅馬正規軍的標準形態，但它的痕跡並未消失，反而以變形的形式活在危機的兩端。羅馬帝國東部的希臘語行省與外族輔助軍中，長柄直刺矛配合橢圓或圓盾的組合仍在使用；更直接的證據是帕爾米拉軍隊，其重步兵結成方陣，以長矛列陣，據希羅狄安記載，曾在安條克以西的戰場上與羅馬軍正面碰撞。與此同時，羅馬正規軍的裝備在三世紀發生劇變：投槍在加利恩努斯改革之後被棄用，步兵改持長刺矛，盾牌由半圓柱形轉向帶中央盾臍的橢圓形，護甲則由分段甲逐漸讓位於鎖子甲與鱗甲。東方薩珊的裝備以重騎兵為主，人馬皆披鎖子或鱗片鎧甲，長槍配小型圓盾，另有大量弓騎。攻城方面雙方都使用弩炮、投石機與可移動的攻城塔，圍城中的地道與蟻道是奪取高牆的常規手段，薩珊軍在尼西比斯屢次用圍城戰拖垮羅馬守軍，羅馬軍則在安條克與埃梅薩以工程作業換取攻城成果。
kitsEn: The Greek hoplite on the card is a Greek heavy infantryman of the fifth century BC: a bronze or iron helmet, a muscle cuirass sewn from linen and metal strips, a high-ridged round shield, and a short spear about two metres long. The tactical core is the phalanx: shields touching, six to eight ranks deep, the front absorbing the impact while the rear thrusts through the gaps between shields. After AD 232 this classical phalanx had long ceased to be the standard form of the Roman regular army, yet its traces did not vanish; they survived in mutated form at both ends of the crisis. In the Greek-speaking eastern provinces and in the foreign auxiliary units of the Roman army, the combination of a long thrusting spear with an oval or round shield was still in use; the direct evidence is the Palmyrene army, whose heavy infantry was drawn up in a phalanx with long spears and, according to Herodianus, collided with the Roman line in the field west of Antioch. At the same time the equipment of the Roman regular army changed sharply during the third century: the pilum was abandoned after the reforms of Gallienus and the infantry took up the thrusting spear; the shield turned from the half-cylindrical scutum towards an oval clipeus with a central boss; and armour passed gradually from the segmented lorica segmentata to mail and scale. The Sasanians in the east fought mainly with heavy cavalry, horse and rider alike clad in mail or scale, long spear with a small round shield, backed by large numbers of horse archers. On both sides, siege was conducted with ballistae, stone-throwers and movable siege towers, and mines and approaches were the regular means of taking a high wall: the Sasanians wore down the Roman garrison at Nisibis with repeated blockades, and the Romans bought their results at Antioch and Emesa with engineering work.
tactics: 三世紀的戰場戰術，可以用古典方陣的式微與兩套替代方案來說明。古典重步兵方陣依賴接盾與縱深，衝擊力來自整體重量；塞維魯斯改革之後，羅馬主力已換為十營制的密集縱隊，前排為標槍手與輕步兵，其後是持長矛的主力，最後是標槍兵預備隊，作戰時以標槍齊射壓制對手，再以盾牆推進。三世紀中期之後，標槍被長刺矛取代，步兵更加依賴龜甲與楔形隊，配合小隊騎兵分割敵陣，戰術重心從正面衝擊轉向局部包圍與劫掠式遠征。東方薩珊軍團的打法更古老也更具殺傷力：弓騎在兩翼保持距離，靠騎射與佯退消耗對手，追擊時再以重騎兵持長槍衝鋒，260年瓦勒良在埃德薩的敗局正是被這一套圍住。帕爾米拉軍隊是危機中的特例，其重步兵以方陣與長矛列陣，騎兵數量龐大且善用沙漠機動，澤諾比婭曾率騎兵深入埃及，又以安條克為跳板遠征小亞細亞。奧勒良在272年圍攻帕爾米拉時，希羅狄安記下了具體戰法：羅馬軍一度在幼發拉底河畔佯敗誘敵，帕爾米拉軍追出城後遭預設伏擊；攻城則靠工程作業與強攻結合，守軍以戰象衝擊羅馬陣線，羅馬軍以投石與弓箭射殺戰象。萊茵河與多瑙河方向則由高盧帝國、不列顛政權與部族聯軍進行機動作戰，防守方依托河岸與林地切斷對手的補給線。
tacticsEn: The tactical picture of the third century can be set out as the decline of the classical phalanx and the two replacements that took its place. The classical phalanx relied on touching shields and on depth, and its shock came from mass rather than from individuals; after the Severan reforms the Roman main force was already a dense column on the ten-cohort system, with skirmishers and light troops in front, spear-armed heavy infantry behind them and a reserve of pilum-armed troops at the back, opening with massed pilum volleys to pin the enemy and then advancing behind the wall of shields. After the middle of the third century the pilum was replaced by the thrusting spear, the infantry relied even more heavily on the testudo and on the wedge, and small bodies of cavalry were used to cut up the enemy line: the centre of gravity moved from the frontal assault towards encirclement and towards raiding expeditions. The Sasanian formations in the east were older in style and at least as deadly: horse archers kept their distance on the wings, wearing the enemy down with shot and feigned retreat, and when the pursuit began, heavy cavalry charged with the lance; the defeat of Valerian at Edessa in 260 was produced by exactly that scheme. The Palmyrene army is the special case of the crisis: its heavy infantry was drawn up in a phalanx of long spears, its cavalry was very large in number and skilled in desert manoeuvre, and Zenobia led it deep into Egypt and then used Antioch as a springboard for a raid into Asia Minor. When Aurelian besieged Palmyra in 272, Herodianus recorded the actual method: the Roman troops feigned defeat on the banks of the Euphrates and drew the Palmyrenes out of the city into an ambush; the siege itself combined engineering work with assault, the defenders drove war elephants into the Roman line, and the Romans killed the elephants with stone-throwers and arrows. On the Rhine and the Danube the Gallic Empire, the British authorities and the tribal coalitions fought a war of manoeuvre, the defenders using the river banks and the woodland to cut the supply lines of their opponents.
data: 可以依據的數字大致如下。軍團數：塞維魯斯時代羅馬有二十八個軍團，到三世紀末增至三十三個，但每個軍團的規模縮小；早期帝國一個軍團約五千人，塞維魯斯改制後一般認為降至一千至一千五百人，晚期帝國的常備軍總數大致在四十萬至五十萬之間，另有數萬名盟邦兵。皇帝數：公元235至284年這五十年內，先後出現二十餘位皇帝，絕大多數死於宮變、兵變或戰場。疆域數：259至274年間高盧帝國一度控制高盧、不列顛與西班牙北部，領土約佔帝國西部三分之一；帕爾米拉帝國在260至272年間控制敘利亞、巴勒斯坦、埃及與小亞細亞東部。錢幣數：塞維魯斯時代的銀幣德納里烏斯含銀量約五成，到加利恩努斯時期跌至一成上下，260年代只剩幾個百分點；奧勒良於274年重整幣制，銀幣含銀量回到約四至五成，銅幣則改為各地自行鑄造的小額貨幣。兵力數：希羅狄安記錄澤諾比婭麾下約七萬人，數字應視為古代作者的自述；奧勒良在安條克以西投入的解圍部隊與皇帝主力合計數萬人。圍城數：尼西比斯一城在230至244年間遭波斯圍攻數次；260年瓦勒良在埃德薩戰敗被俘；272年帕爾米拉被攻陷並毀滅；274年高盧帝國在特里爾與里昂一線崩解。距離數：安條克至埃梅薩約二百公里，至帕爾米拉約二百一十公里，羅馬軍在沙漠中追擊帕爾米拉騎兵的補給線拉長到數百公里，這是澤諾比婭得以脫身的原因之一。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly as follows. Legions: under Severus Rome had twenty-eight legions; by the end of the third century there were thirty-three, though the size of each shrank. An early imperial legion numbered about five thousand men, and after the Severan reforms it is generally held to have fallen to between one thousand and one thousand five hundred; the total regular army of the late empire lay roughly between four hundred thousand and five hundred thousand, with tens of thousands of foederati besides. Emperors: in the fifty years from AD 235 to 284 more than twenty emperors appeared in turn, the overwhelming majority of them dying in palace coups, military revolts or on the field. Territory: between 259 and 274 the Gallic Empire controlled Gaul, Britain and northern Spain, roughly a third of the western empire; between 260 and 272 the Palmyrene Empire held Syria, Palestine, Egypt and eastern Asia Minor. Money: under Severus the silver denarius carried about half its nominal weight in silver; by the time of Gallienus this had fallen to around a tenth, and in the 260s to only a few percent. Aurelian reformed the coinage in 274, bringing the silver content of the denarius back to roughly forty or fifty per cent, while the bronze coinage was turned over to locally struck small change. Troop numbers: Herodianus puts Zenobia's army at about seventy thousand, a figure that should be read as an ancient author's own reckoning; the relief force Aurelian sent west of Antioch and the emperor's main body together amounted to tens of thousands. Sieges: the single fortress of Nisibis was besieged by the Persians several times between 230 and 244; Valerian was defeated and captured at Edessa in 260; Palmyra was stormed and destroyed in 272; the Gallic Empire came apart along the line of Trier and Lyons in 274. Distances: about two hundred kilometres from Antioch to Emesa and about two hundred and ten from Antioch to Palmyra; the Roman supply line, extended across the desert in pursuit of the Palmyrene horse, ran to several hundred kilometres, and that was one of the reasons Zenobia escaped.
cause: 危機的成因是多層的，但沒有一層是單一原因。第一層是皇帝與軍隊的關係出了問題。塞維魯斯王朝末期，皇位依賴禁衛軍與禁軍推舉，禁軍首領的權力遠超皇帝；亞歷山大·塞維魯斯缺乏軍隊支持的處境，最終在232年安條克兵變中暴露，御用法學家烏爾比安被士兵殺死，敘利亞軍團另立烏拉尼烏斯，帝國的權威只剩下誰能讓軍團滿意。第二層是安全策略的破產。塞維魯斯家族曾把大股兵力抽離邊疆，以velatio撤防的方式換取安寧，實際上等於把整條多瑙河與萊茵河線暴露給部族，三世紀初阿勒曼尼人大舉越萊茵河而來，證明這套策略只是延後了衝突。第三層是薩珊王朝的興起，它把原先的邊境部落聯盟整合成一個具備重步兵、攻城能力與持久補給的帝國，羅馬在東方連續失去亞美尼亞、亞述與美索不達米亞的城市。第四層是結構性的經濟與兵源壓力：安東尼瘟疫與西普里安瘟疫削弱了稅基與徵兵，戰爭的開銷卻不減，軍隊因欠餉而頻頻嘩變，銀幣貶值又讓邊軍的實際購買力崩潰，於是兵變、換皇帝、再兵變成為常態，最終在235年亞歷山大·塞維魯斯被士兵刺殺時徹底爆開。
causeEn: The causes of the crisis were layered, and no single layer explains it. The first was the breakdown of the relationship between emperor and army. In the late Severan dynasty the throne depended on the Praetorian Guard and on what the soldiers would acclaim, and the power of the guard commander far exceeded that of the emperor; the position of Alexander Severus, who had no army's support behind him, was laid bare by the mutiny at Antioch in 232, when the jurist Ulpian was killed by the troops and the Syrian legions acclaimed Uranius Antoninus, leaving imperial authority resting on nothing more than who could satisfy the legions. The second was the bankruptcy of the security policy. The Severans had drawn large bodies of troops away from the frontier, buying quiet with a strategy of velatio, which in effect exposed the whole Danube and Rhine line to the tribes; the great Alamannic crossing of the Rhine in the early third century showed that the policy had only postponed the conflict. The third was the rise of the Sasanian state, which gathered the old frontier tribal confederacy into an empire with heavy infantry, siege capacity and durable supply lines, and the Roman Empire lost the cities of Armenia, Assyria and Mesopotamia in succession in the east. The fourth was structural pressure on the economy and on recruitment: the Antonine plague and the plague of Cyprian thinned the tax base and the manpower, while the cost of war did not fall; the army went unpaid and revolted repeatedly; the debasement of the coinage destroyed the real purchasing power of the frontier soldiers; and so mutiny, the change of emperor and further mutiny became the normal order of things, until in 235, when Alexander Severus was stabbed by his own soldiers, the whole thing burst open.
impact: 危機的後果首先是帝國體制的重寫。軍人皇帝統治了半個世紀，皇位不再是元老院與皇帝家族的事，而是軍團與禁衛軍協商的結果；加利恩努斯於260年代禁止元老擔任軍職，進一步切斷了貴族與軍隊的傳統聯繫，也把帝國推向軍人君主制。第二是軍隊的重組：三世紀的邊疆守備軍與精銳近衛軍分立，軍團規模由五千人縮到一千上下，後備兵源不足迫使帝國大量採用盟邦兵，這條路最終通向四世紀的同盟軍體制。第三是財政與貨幣改革的壓力：連年戰爭造成的貴金屬外流與貶值，最終以奧勒良的幣制改革與戴克里先301年的最高價令告一段落，帝國重新以實物稅與固定物價重建經濟秩序。第四是東西分家的隱形預言：帝國在危機中失去不列顛、高盧與北非的穩定控制，西部皇帝出現在高盧與不列顛，說明西部的權力中心已與地中海東岸脫鉤；476年西羅馬滅亡並非危機的直接結果，卻是危機留下的結構性脆弱的最終兌現。最後是希臘重步兵那一套經驗的落幕：古典方陣作為作戰學術在西方退場，但接盾以維持縱深、以長矛貫穿前列的原理改頭換面留在晚期羅馬的密集縱隊與拜占庭的禁軍當中，成為四世紀以後軍隊仍在使用的骨架。
impactEn: The first consequence of the crisis was the rewriting of the imperial system. Soldier-emperors ruled for half a century, and the throne ceased to be a matter for the senate and the imperial family, becoming something negotiated between the legions and the guard; Gallienus barred senators from military commands in the 260s, severing the traditional link between aristocracy and army and pushing the empire towards military monarchy. The second was the restructuring of the army: the third-century split between frontier garrison and elite field troops, the legion shrinking from five thousand men to about a thousand, and the shortage of replacements driving the empire to enlist foederati in large numbers, a road that led to the allied armies of the fourth century. The third was the pressure that produced fiscal and monetary reform: the flight of precious metal and the debasement caused by decades of war were finally addressed by Aurelian's coinage reform and by the maximum price edict of 301, and the empire rebuilt its economic order on taxes in kind and fixed prices. The fourth was the unspoken prophecy of a division into East and West: the empire lost stable control of Britain, Gaul and North Africa during the crisis, western emperors appeared in Gaul and in Britain, and the western centre of gravity had already come loose from the eastern Mediterranean shore; the fall of the western empire in 476 was not a direct result of the crisis but the final cashing-in of the structural fragility the crisis left behind. Last was the passing of the hoplite experience: the classical phalanx retired from the western art of war, but the principle of touching shields to hold depth and of driving the long spear through the front rank survived under other names in the dense columns of the late Roman army and in the Byzantine guards, forming the skeleton that armies continued to use into the fourth century and beyond.
result: 到公元284年卡魯斯即位、戴克里先於293年推行四帝共治時，危機的帳本大致已經算清。西部方面，奧勒良在272至274年間攻下特里爾與里昂，平定高盧帝國，不列顛與西班牙北部也陸續歸順，重新納入行省體系；東部的帕爾米拉在272年被攻陷後遭毀滅，澤諾比婭被俘後傳說在羅馬被軟禁至死，瓦巴拉薩斯下落不明，敘利亞、巴勒斯坦與埃及重回帝國控制。北方，哥特人與阿勒曼尼人被以盟邦兵身分收編，代替羅馬人守備多瑙河與萊茵河，同時在邊境留下新的隱患，407年的大遷移即由此發端。東方，薩珊在260年俘虜瓦勒良、攻下安條克與凱撒里亞之後一度深入，卻也在280年代被擊退；普羅布斯在281年取得的和約以割讓美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞的數個行省為代價，換來約二十年的邊境和平，直到298年戴克里先在薩塔拉擊敗納爾塞，才把這些行省收回。就兵器與戰術的層面看，這場危機的結果是古典希臘重步兵方陣在歐洲戰場的正式退場：方陣在希臘世界本身早已被長槍方陣與弓箭手取代，在羅馬則被投槍縱隊與分段甲吸收，三世紀的裝備變革最終定型為長刺矛加橢圓盾的密集縱隊，與薩珊重騎兵、弓騎並存，構成晚期羅馬戰爭的基本樣態。帝國沒有滅亡，反而以更小的軍隊、更鞏固的邊疆與更集權的統治延續下去；危機真正終結的標誌不是某一場戰役的勝負，而是戴克里先把皇帝、將軍、財政與軍隊分置於四套不同的人事制度之中，讓兵變不再能直接推舉皇帝。
resultEn: By the time Carus was acclaimed in AD 284 and Diocletian launched the Tetrarchy in 293, the account of the crisis had been roughly settled. In the west Aurelian took Trier and Lyons between 272 and 274 and put down the Gallic Empire; Britain and northern Spain came back to obedience in turn and were reabsorbed into the provincial system. In the east Palmyra was stormed in 272 and razed; Zenobia was captured and, according to the story, kept under guard in Rome until her death, and Vaballathus disappeared from the record; Syria, Palestine and Egypt returned to imperial control. In the north the Goths and Alamanni were enrolled as foederati and took over the defence of the Danube and the Rhine in place of Roman troops, while planting the seeds of the trouble that would break out in the great migration of 407. In the east the Sasanians, after taking Valerian prisoner in 260 and seizing Antioch and Caesarea, pushed deep for a time but were driven back in the 280s; the peace Probus concluded in 281 cost the empire several provinces of Mesopotamia and Armenia and bought about twenty years of quiet on that frontier, until Diocletian defeated Narseh at Satala in 298 and took the provinces back. On the level of arms and tactics, the result of the crisis was the formal retirement of the classical Greek hoplite phalanx from the European battlefield: in the Greek world itself the phalanx had long been superseded by the sarissa phalanx and by archers, and in Rome it had been absorbed by the pilum column and by segmented armour, so that the equipment changes of the third century settled into dense columns of thrusting spear and oval shield, existing alongside Sasanian heavy cavalry and horse archers as the basic shape of late Roman war. The empire did not die; it went on, with a smaller army, a firmer frontier and a more centralised government. The real end of the crisis was not the result of any single battle, but the fact that Diocletian placed the emperors, the generals, the finances and the army in four separate systems of personnel, so that a mutiny could no longer acclaim an emperor directly.
